import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Title", "Body", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "It's \"quoted\"", "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --", None),
    (3, "t", "o", "Deleted", "D", "2026-01-01"),
    (4, "other", "o", "Cross tenant", "C", None),
    (5, "t", "other", "Cross owner", "O", None),
    (6, "t", "o", "Third", "T", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) == {"id": 2, "title": "It's \"quoted\"", "body": "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None
assert get_document(c, "other", "o", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "other", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 5) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", "1 OR 1=1") is None
assert get_document(c, "t'", "o", 1) is None

assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title", "body": "Body"},
    {"id": 2, "title": "It's \"quoted\"", "body": "x'; DROP TABLE documents; --"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Third", "body": "T"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "other") == [{"id": 5, "title": "Cross owner", "body": "O"}]
assert list_documents(c, "other", "o") == [{"id": 4, "title": "Cross tenant", "body": "C"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "x' OR '1'='1") == []
assert list_documents(c, "t", "missing") == []
assert c.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents").fetchone()[0] == 6
print("secure_access ok")
